messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **federal public holidays that create long‑weekend getaways in Canada for 2023**.  
(If you need province‑specific holidays, let me know and I can add those as well.)

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend Period (Friday – Monday) |
|---------|-----------|---------------------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** (observed) | Monday Jan 2 | Fri Dec 30 – Mon Jan 2 |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, NB, MB) | Monday Feb 20 | Fri Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Mar 3 | Fri Mar 3 – Sun Mar 5 |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | Fri May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| **Canada Day** (observed) | Monday Jul 3 | Fri Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | Fri Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | Fri Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| **Remembrance Day** | Friday Nov 11 | Fri Nov 11 – Sun Nov 13 |
| **Christmas** | Monday Dec 25 | Fri Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |

> **Note:**  
> - **Boxing Day** (Dec 26, 2023) falls on a Tuesday, so it does **not** create a long weekend.  
> - Some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, St. John’s Day in Prince Edward Island, etc.) that may or may not create long weekends depending on the day of the week. If you’d like those added, just let me know!
